caveats: Only four devices meet policy criteria for replacement based on hardware telemetry findings; six devices have no hardware findings and cannot be flagged for replacement.

findings.statement: Proposed replacement under P-1 for acme-macbook-1 (MacBook Pro) due to battery health requiring service with 1049 cycles.
Proposed replacement under P-2 for acme-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) due to battery health requiring service with 1157 cycles and 3% free disk space (about 27 GB free, 5 days to full).
Proposed replacement under P-3 for acme-dell-9 (Dell XPS 15) due to battery health requiring service and memory usage averaging 94% on 16 GB RAM.
Proposed replacement under P-4 for acme-macbook-4 (MacBook Pro) due to soldered storage at 2% free space (about 10 GB free, 11 days to full).
acme-macbook-2 (MacBook Pro) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.
acme-thinkpad-10 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.
acme-mac-5 (Mac mini) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.
acme-macbook-3 (MacBook Pro) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.
acme-macbook-7 (MacBook Pro) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.
acme-macbook-6 (MacBook Pro) has no active hardware findings in telemetry and cannot be flagged for replacement.

args.summary: Proposals P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 have been created to flag acme-macbook-1 (MacBook Pro), acme-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon), acme-dell-9 (Dell XPS 15), and acme-macbook-4 (MacBook Pro) for replacement due to active hardware findings. The remaining six devices in the fleet show no hardware issues in telemetry, so policy does not permit flagging them for replacement. Cheaper component upgrade options exist for acme-macbook-1 (battery upgrade order), acme-thinkpad-8 (battery and storage upgrade orders), and acme-dell-9 (battery and RAM upgrade orders).
